decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (S-3A, Location Plan Received 21/03/2011 and S-1A, S-2A Received 01/04/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern elevation of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The proposed extensions shall be used solely for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse and as such shall not be used as a separate, self-contained residential unit.
description: Erection of a proposed single storey rear extension and a single storey side extension
